# CheckerLeak.com — Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Index
> CheckerLeak.com is a high-speed, carrier-grade bulk contact verification, HLR lookup, and multi-channel intelligence platform supporting 240+ countries, 102+ platform footprint checkers, and instant automated pay-as-you-go verification credits.

## Core Capabilities
- **Enterprise Grade Privacy (Zero-KYC)**: Anonymous account creation with zero identity logs, zero data retention, and instant automated pay-as-you-go credit activation.
- **ITU-T E.164 Phone Normalization & Validation**: Instant offline validation, country code resolution, and line-type classification across 240+ countries.
- **HLR Carrier & Fraud Detection**: Real-time Mobile Network Operator (MNO) and MVNO identification, active roaming signal detection, SIM swap & port-out risk, and disposable VoIP/burner number blocking.
- **Native Apple iMessage & FaceTime Detection**: Direct hardware-level IDS probe verifying iOS blue-bubble status and APNs routing without sending SMS or notifications.
- **Universal Messenger Intelligence**:
  - WhatsApp & WhatsApp Business (registration, bio, avatar, business catalog, days active)
  - Telegram (registration, username profile, account age in days, gender/age estimation)
  - Viber (active status, account duration, avatar, age & gender)
  - Android RCS (GSMA Universal Profile 2.4 status)
  - Signal, Line, Botim, Zalo, WeChat Real-Name, KakaoTalk
- **102+ Specialized Verification Engines Across 6 Categories**:
  1. Social & Messaging (43 engines): Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber, iMessage, RCS, Apple, Facebook, Instagram, LINE, Botim, LinkedIn, Zalo, VKontakte, Signal, Twitter/X, TikTok, Microsoft, Snapchat, Messenger, GoTo, Threads, Band, BongaCams, Rabota.ru, RusDate, GitHub, Discord & Nitro, OK.ru, KakaoTalk, WeChat.
  2. Crypto Exchanges (12 engines): Binance (Phone & Email), KuCoin (Phone & Email), OKX (Phone & Email), HTX (Phone & Email), CoinW (Phone & Email), Crypto.com (Phone & Email).
  3. Email Verification & SMTP Probes (19 engines): Apple Email, Facebook Email, Amazon Email, Instagram Email, Netflix Email, LinkedIn Email, Twitter Email, Gmail, Yandex, Mail.ru, Outlook, Yahoo, Pornhub Email, TikTok Email.
  4. Fintech & Neobanks (4 engines): PayPal Account, Revolut Presence, Wise (TransferWise), CashApp $Cashtag.
  5. Fraud, Risk & Telecom HLR (8 engines): Phone Number Validation, Number Active Checker, High-value Users Checker, Carrier Detection, Advanced US Carrier, Sideline, SIM Swap & Port-Out Risk, Disposable & Burner Number Risk.
  6. E-Commerce, Mobility & Streaming (16 engines): Amazon, MAX (HBO), Netflix, Spotify, DHL, Airbnb, Temu, Wheely, Uber/Careem, Glovo COD Trust Score, Talabat Gulf, DoorDash & DashPass, Avito Seller/Buyer, Grab Super-App.

## Primary API Endpoints
- `POST /v1/verify/single` — Real-time cascading verification for a single contact.
- `POST /v1/verify/batch` — Multi-threaded high-throughput batch verification.
- `POST /v1/verify/service` — Targeted probe against any specific engine from the 102+ catalog.
- `POST /v1/batch/upload-file` — Bulk CSV/TXT list cleaning with 11-column enriched export.
- `GET /v1/geo/detect` — Geolocation detection and carrier routing recommendations.
- `GET /v1/billing/plans` — Transparent pricing tiers ($19 Starter, $49 Pro, $149 Enterprise).
